select_fp8_moe_backend: select an FP8 MoE backend from available backends based on config and platform
make_fp8_moe_kernel: create a FusedMoEKernel with prepare/finalize, experts, and shared experts for FP8 MoE
convert_to_fp8_moe_kernel_format: convert FP8 MoE weights and scales to the format required by the selected backend
make_fp8_moe_quant_config: create a FusedMoEQuantConfig with scales for the specified FP8 backend
backend_to_kernel_cls: map an FP8 MoE backend enum to its corresponding kernel class implementations
